about: The elements known to fail each property of the oracle scorecard (test/fidelity/oracle-report.test.ts), per sample (and per sample@matched, its position-matched comparison). This is the gate: an element failing a property that is not listed here fails its sample, whether it passed before or is new; pass rates never fail one. npm run fidelity:ratchet takes off every element that passes after a run (one that is not measurable any more stays) and adds one only with --add "<reason>", recorded in reasons with its date and whether the drawing or the comparator made it fail. This is the fix list, by element id.
